'''2023 San Diego Super Open''' was a Players Committee major event in San Diego, California, 20–22 January 2023. [[Drew Lichtenstein]] is listed first among the published constructed pairs.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-02-san-diego-super-open/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' San Diego, California
* '''Dates:''' 20–22 January 2023
